verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents loading custom tools into a self-hosted instance as MCP servers, configured in librechat.yaml or added at runtime from the MCP Settings panel. Its agent tool library also lists Actions and Skills, and a Skills docs page exists. However, the pack shows no documented authoring format or spec for writing a LibreChat skill or plugin. Missing for 10: a documented skill/plugin file format or authoring guide, evidence of a local skill-loading workflow, and hands-on corroboration of building and loading a custom tool.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally

citations.quote: allowing you to integrate everything from file system access, web browsers, specialized APIs, to custom business tools
Adding and updating servers at runtime from the MCP Settings panel, without editing a config file or restarting
advanced features like MCP servers and agents
The Tools and Skills controls open searchable libraries for built-in capabilities, tools, MCP servers, Actions, and Skills.
